Lecture 9 — Partial Fractions (DRAFT, MODULE NOT RELEASED)

Slide 1: Proper vs improper rational functions
  Divide first when deg(numerator) >= deg(denominator).

Slide 2: Distinct linear factors
  P(x)/((x-a)(x-b)) = A/(x-a) + B/(x-b)

Slide 3: Repeated and irreducible quadratic factors
  One term per power; Bx + C over each irreducible quadratic.
